benefits.zh: breathe in 和 breathe out 常見於伸展、運動和放鬆呼吸的指示中。
benefits.en: Breathe in and breathe out are often used in stretching, exercise and calm-breathing instructions.

benefits.titleZh: 自然地談論空氣和氣味
benefits.titleEn: Talk naturally about air and smells
benefits.zh: 你可以用 breathe in 表達吸入新鮮空氣、海風，以及食物或花朵的香味。
benefits.en: You can breathe in fresh air, sea air or the smell of food and flowers.

benefits.titleZh: 清楚描述如何控制呼吸
benefits.titleEn: Describe how someone controls their breathing
benefits.zh: breathe the air out slowly 和 breathe it in deeply 等表達，可以幫助你清楚說明呼吸方式。
benefits.en: Expressions such as breathe the air out slowly and breathe it in deeply help you give clear breathing instructions.

benefits.titleZh: 描述某事物重新充滿活力
benefits.zh: breathe life 或 energy into something 可以表示某人或某個構思令團隊、故事、地方或活動重新充滿生氣。
benefits.en: Breathe life or energy into something can describe a person or idea making a team, story, place or activity feel fresh and lively again.

questions.answer: The new director has breathed fresh energy into a show that many people had stopped watching.
